source_modifications: none; browser ABI is a separate GPL-3.0-only source file
runtime: standalone WebAssembly reactor, separate memory per processor

settings.native_input: quad/5.1 original planes, fused speaker mapping plus interleave; mono/stereo retain direct JavaScript layout stores by measured policy
settings.downmix_arithmetic: double expression rounded once to float32, matching the established Web Audio speaker mapping

soundtouch.simd.wasm.automatic_playback: non-1x playback when native WebAssembly SIMD is supported
